checkpoint: Lowest source-validation CE, checked each 50 updates
selection: All training/validation selections fixed using identity hashes before model fitting
label_range_policy: Exclude outside [0,4.5], never clip; audited zero out-of-range source labels
physical_basis: Verified Stage2A FSPS QSF12, positive simplex coefficients, actual responses; shared coefficients across candidate z
amplitude: Nonnegative per-candidate weighted projection, exact shape rescaling for stability
normalization: Median absolute valid flux; fallback median valid sigma, then internal scale1 if no observations. Same factor divides f and sigma; no measured zeros fabricated
EBV: Value and available recorded separately; omitted from primary neural inputs. Numerical placeholder masked and never used as measurement.
brightness_control: N1_brightness supplies explicit log10 flux scale; primary all models remove amplitude
augmentation: Separate N1_noise and N2_noise: sigma multiplier in {1,3,10,30}, fresh Gaussian incremental variance, source labels only. Common amplitude scaling is already an exact normalization symmetry
wrong_response: Fixed RNG921 permutation of full responses, not optimized on target. N1_shuffled trained with wrong metadata; all primary models also get post-hoc wrong-response diagnostics
gate2: Each primary model validation CE below uniform log(300)-0.5, source NMAD<0.12 and outliers<0.30 per survey. If underfit, one source-only extension to 2000/1600 updates allowed.
gate3: N2 must improve both source balanced CE and synthetic held-out-filter outliers over N1 to justify expanded seeds or data. Otherwise only the fixed small target diagnostic.
expansion: Only three-seed promising primary models if Gate3 passes; no larger hyperparameter sweep
